name: Codex (CLI, VS Code Extension)
description: OpenAI Codex standalone CLI, VS Code extension, and persistent Codex state.

cliVersion.description: Codex standalone CLI release to install. Use latest, a release such as 0.143.0, or none.

extensionVersion.description: openai.chatgpt VS Code extension version to install. Use latest, an exact Marketplace version, or none.

volumePath.description: Absolute container path used as the complete CODEX_HOME. The first two proposed paths are Feature-managed volumes; /workspaces/.codex persists across GitHub Codespaces rebuilds; any other path must be mounted by the user.

fixPermissions.description: Recursively update ownership and permissions on the selected volumePath at container start. Disable to only verify access.

permissionsOwner.description: Recursive owner for directories and regular files: auto, none, or a chown-compatible USER[:GROUP]. Auto uses the remote user except for the shared volume, where ownership is preserved.

directoryMode.description: Recursive directory permissions. Auto uses private permissions, or a+rwX for the shared volume.

fileMode.description: Recursive regular-file permissions. Auto preserves existing executable bits and uses private permissions, or a+rwX for the shared volume.
